items.t: **On rails, not open-ended.** The character system is expansive; the plot system matches its depth but every walk is gated by the storyform's fixed signposts. The rails are Dramatica's order; the tropes only fill what the rails allow.

paragraphs.main_effort: The fabula doc, wave 1 — IN FLIGHT.

phases.t: **Two boresight loops walked**, all recs ruled — the fabula-first shape, the nodes/edges/rails method, the fetch order, the acquisitions order, drafts read first.
**The plot sweep** — 2,429 titles pooled, judged, RANGE 2,429/2,429; the loose-Zotero blind spot folded in.
**Uploads** — seven rounds landed ~95 books; shelf closed at canon 40/43 held, 10 titles marked "no copy".

**The fabula doc (wave 1)** — v0.1.1, 27 KB, RANGE clean: the event record, typed causal edges, the world clock, origin moments (L5 · L7 · L8 · L9 · L10), the handshake; Tori's five pre-story events filled from her node, nothing invented. Six calls ruled; the state architecture patched to v1.1.0.

**The trope graph (wave 2)** — v0.1.0, 23 KB, RANGE clean. 135 book nodes (Schmidt 55 · Propp 31 · Tobias 20 · Campbell 17 · Vogler 12); 1,678 TV Tropes plot tropes fetched, 1,034 keyed by 8 PS batches (RANGE caught one guessed batch and two id errors); 2,584 trope-link edges + 31 same_as; 23 empty nodes; the walk rule and a worked example on real nodes.
**The syuzhet (wave 3)** — the plot doc revised in place to v0.2.0/0.2.1 as the told order: THE TOLD ORDER section (Genette, Sternberg), the plot card reads the fabula, M2 row 9 linked on P4/P7.
**The OXO movements ↔ acts map (77-L)** — six movements onto four signpost acts; then seat every node.
